Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Many thanks for [the payment](../others.html#160) which comes pleasantly early this year.

My [Spaniards and Moors](../books.html#126) are progressing, but I suppose I had better finish all before I send them, as if abridgement is needful it is better done on a whole than on a part.

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
